'''Bloom Canyon''' is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location that was featured in ''[[HS17|Those Darn Electabuzz!]]''. It was unnamed in the Japanese version.

Bloom Canyon is part of a mountainous area, with unpredictable conditions including whirlpools and strong winds. Star {{p|Electabuzz}} [[baseball]]er [[Corey Demario]] often trains in the area with his {{p|Charizard}} [[nickname]]d Don. Corey and his family also operate a ranch nearby.
